notes.title: Gatling Gun has been released for World of Guns!
notes.content:
Gatling Gun has been released for World of Guns!

What's interesting in this model:
Disassembly/Assembly: 174 parts
Operation:
1. Fire, Unload, Reload
2Additional: Rear Sight Adjustment 
3. HD textures
4. Cutaway mode

notes.title: Glock 17 Airsoft pistol has been released for World of Guns: VR!
notes.content:
Glock 17 Airsoft pistol has been released for World of Guns:VR!

What's interesting in this model:
Disassembly/Assembly: 76 parts
Operation:
1. Fire, Reload, Safety, 
2.HD textures
3.Real sounds 
4. Cutaway mode, flying bullet

notes.title: Oculus Rift support, control improvement
notes.content:
A major update has been released for the World of Guns:VR
Oculus Rift support has been added!

- Tutorial has been updated for VR controllers
[img]http://data.ultimate-disassembly.com/pics/news/news_vr_2.jpg[/img]
- Two types of control have been updated.

  By Laser Pointer with two options
[img]http://data.ultimate-disassembly.com/pics/news/news_vr.jpg[/img]

  By Hand
[img]http://data.ultimate-disassembly.com/pics/news/news_vr_1.jpg[/img]
